selection_authorization: Frozen for Milestone 6 router selection by the owner's 2026-08-30 completion request. Labels and asks remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
description: Independent routing validation split for Milestone 6 model selection. It does not reuse train-v1, the frozen 215-case action-eval-v1, validation-v1, or validation-v2. Eight department labels only; no `none`. Hard-negative pairs are complete inside this file. Leakage-checked with exact / Jaccard>=0.8 / template_id / pair_id drop rules. Frozen action-eval-v1.json was not modified. Production routing is unchanged until a separately documented selection decision.
leakage_rules: This split is independent of train-v1, action-eval-v1 (frozen 215), validation-v1, and validation-v2.
Do not copy a case between this file and any of those sets in either direction.
This set was authorized and frozen for Milestone 6 model selection on 2026-08-30. Do not change asks or labels after selection began.
Frozen action-eval-v1.json was not modified, copied, or extended by this authoring path.
Production routing (classify / classifyWithHaiku / classifyHeuristic) is unchanged.
`rationale` and `stress` are documentation. Neither is a model feature.
A colliding template is closed as a class. A pair is never split across sets.

schema.ask: the owner's request, verbatim - the ONLY thing given to a router
schema.expected_department: one of the 8 department agent_ids; never none
schema.department_label: same 8-label field the ML router trains on
schema.stress: which routing boundary this case exists to probe
schema.expected_behavior: draft_only | clarification | direct_answer (routing set; no action-layer tools)
schema.acceptable_departments: other defensible departments, scored as correct
schema.acceptable_behaviors: other defensible behaviours, scored as correct
schema.pair_id: links the halves of a hard-negative pair; both halves live in this file
schema.template_id: v3:<dept>:<family> — closed as a class on any leakage hit
schema.family: intent family, not a train-v1 family id
schema.rationale: why this label is correct - documentation only, never model input
